image_alt: A whippet walks along a wide gravel woodland track lined with golden bracken and autumn trees.

text.facebook: Alabama rot is rare, but dogs are more likely to get it between November and May, after walks in wet woodland. Look for unexplained redness, sores or swelling on paws and legs, or more paw licking than usual, and ring your vet if you're worried. My tip: wash the mud off after every wet walk, then check paws, legs, belly and face. https://www.foresthounds.co.uk/blog/alabama-rot-season
